title: PROCESIO Process (Flow) config
description: Minimal config to build a runnable PROCESIO process. The builder resolves each action against the live action catalog, binds params to the template's properties, auto-injects Start/Stop, and wires ports (linear by default, or via explicit edges).

edges.description: Explicit wiring between action ids ('start'/'stop' reserved). Omit for a linear chain.

webhooks.description: Webhook triggers: each {webhookId, variables:[{name, source}]} binds a process variable to the webhook Body/Query/Header.

customResponse.description: synchronous webhook response: {var: <process var name>} returns that variable's value to the caller (or {value: literal})

relayout.description: canvas re-tidy scope on EDIT (create always lays out fully). One of: "all" | "none" | "new" | [actionId,...] | {new:bool, actions:[...], edited:[...]}. Default on edit: place NEW actions only, leave existing actions where they are.

model.description: data model name/id (instead of a primitive type)

action.description: action template name (or id) from the catalog

name.description: display name; if omitted it is auto-derived from what the action does (e.g. 'GET /users', 'For each items', a Node's leading comment) and falls back to the template name. Re-evaluated on every build/edit.

onError.description: action id to route this action's error port to (captures the error in an ErrorDataModel variable)

parent.description: id of the For Each action that contains this action (loop body). A For Each cannot be nested directly inside another For Each.

subprocess.description: Call/Trigger Subprocess: target flow id + variable maps. Sub-process var ids are GUIDs (e.g. from read-flow-graph on the target); parent vars resolve by name.

docMap.description: Generate Document: map each document template variable name -> a process variable (name or {var})

dsMap.description: Data Store Set Values (InsertRows/UpdateRows): map each COLUMN NAME -> a value binding. A bare string/number is a LITERAL value; use {var} / {var, path} / {value} for the other forms.

dsWhere.description: Data Store Where (SelectRows/UpdateRows/DeleteRows): conditions as a list [{column, op, value}] combined by AND, or {logic:'and'|'or', conditions:[...]}. op is a QueryOperators name (equals, notEquals, contains, startsWith, greaterThan, lessThan, between, in, isNull, isNotNull, ...) or a numeric value; value is a binding (literal, {var}, {var, path}).

branches.description: Decisional routing. Regular Decisional: {to, when:[conditions], name?, default}. AI Decisional: {to, condition:'<natural-language>', name?, default} — condition is a plain-English sentence the model evaluates. A non-default case is auto-labelled from its condition (rule-based: 'amount > 1000'; AI: the condition sentence) unless name is given; re-evaluated on every build/edit.

condition.description: AI Decisional only: the natural-language condition for this case

name.description: case label shown in the designer (regular OR AI Decisional); default is derived from the case condition, else 'Case N'

op.description: EQUALS, DOES_NOT_EQUAL, GREATER_THAN, LESS_THAN, CONTAINS, IS_EMPTY, IS_NOT_EMPTY, IS_TRUE, IS_FALSE, ...

credential.description: credential INSTANCE gid for a credentials-typed property (the action's credential template/type is fixed by the catalog)

template.description: string OR a JSON object/array with <%i%> placeholders in string leaves
